# Main CPU base

Runtime address of block 0 (MN103 main program) offset 0.

**Category:** layout · **Address:** `0x60021020` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Runtime address = 0x60021020 + offset in the decoded block 0 payload. The boot stub runs first at flash 0x40780020.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Load base and boot stub address read from the boot code. Source: [E-M5 III boot and section loading](../sources/em5n.boot.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Patches placed with this base, such as the focus-stacking change, work on the camera. Source: [Focus stacking lens check patch](../sources/em5n.focus-patch.md).
